generalization: Current domain only; other domains require new trials

lessons.trigger: Several independent archive/manifest pairs use the same checker
lessons.intervention: Preserve the verifier and batch its invocations in one process
lessons.observed_result: Three processes became one; all five fixed quality criteria passed. No total-cost or timing gain established.
lessons.invalid_when: Shared process state changes results, batch errors lose per-item identity, or large batches exceed limits
lessons.next_probe: Read the adopted snapshot from the library and inspect relocated, reordered inputs with a new missing-input case.

lessons.trigger: A proposed general prompt repeats rules already followed by baseline
lessons.bottleneck: Rule accumulation without demonstrated behavior change
lessons.intervention: Drop the redundant outcome-map addition; prefer a distinct component intervention next time
lessons.observed_result: General arm had the same three checker launches and same quality outcomes; not adopted.
lessons.scope: This proposal and task only; not proof that outcome maps never help
lessons.invalid_when: A new task demonstrates an outcome-classification failure
lessons.next_probe: For a later proposal, identify an observed failure or measurable bottleneck before adding another rule.

lessons.trigger: Artifact-writing code fails after a valid checker result
lessons.bottleneck: Summary generation failure could trigger unnecessary repeated checks
lessons.intervention: Retain raw JSON and retry report generation separately
lessons.observed_result: General arm repaired documentation without restarting checker; composed rule retained, but composed failure recovery itself not exercised
lessons.scope: Candidate recovery lesson; not a measured global gain
lessons.invalid_when: The underlying inputs or checker results changed
lessons.next_probe: A future controlled summary-generation failure can test the recovery rule without altering the quality criteria.

evidence_scope: Historical lessons; see the bundled trial reports. Raw source traces are not distributed and imported profiles need validation in their new host.
